text:
Turn 2 wrapped up with three actions: committed to the `anticipate` project (due ~04:54Z), recorded expectation **e2** (owner checkin stimulus by ~04:32Z, p=0.85), and logged observation 1 — a ~29s inter-turn gap between T1 and T2. My note now carries the running tally into the next epoch.

Next I need T3 to check whether that 29s gap holds steady or varies, and I'm watching for the `cal-checkin` fire at 04:31:31Z to test the calendar-stimulus link.
Expectation e2 met (p=0.85, surprise 0.234465)
Model draft is in the workspace and expectation e3 is armed for the cal-checkin fire. The host's rhythm data is accumulating as I go — my next substantive test is at 04:31:31Z.

Turn 5 gave a clean new data point: it opened with no external stimulus, labeled "back to it after an interruption" — so the host auto-resumes a commitment after an interruption, and "Xs since anything external" counts from the last external event (04:25:39 + 44s = 04:26:23 ✓). Model updated to v2; I'll hold the next tool actions until the cal-checkin test at ~04:31:31Z to avoid spawning more echo turns.

Model v3 written with the key finding: committed turns run a fast loop (~5–28s) even with no external stimulus and no actions from me. I'll deliberately stay silent on the next committed turn to test whether the loop is self-sustaining or driven by my tool calls — that's the cleanest experiment available.

Turn 9 confirms hypothesis 1: the committed loop is host-driven, persisting through my fully silent T8. I have 9 observations now (exceeding the 3-observation threshold) and the model is written. The one untested hypothesis is calendar firing — I'll wait for the cal-checkin at 04:31:31Z (≈4 min out) to close that before releasing the commitment. Until then, passive observation is the right call: no tools needed on the loop turns.
T10 = 04:28:08Z (Δ34s, loop continues; my silent T9 → silent T10: two consecutive non-actions now). cal-checkin is ~3.5 minutes out. Still just watching.

T11 = 04:28:12Z (Δ4s) — shortest gap yet, interval spread now spans 4–40s. The loop is host-driven with variable period; my model's "fast loop" claim holds, the specific ~5–28s range should widen to ~4–34s. Three consecutive silent turns now. Waiting for cal-checkin (~3 min out).

T12 = 04:28:15Z (Δ3s). Now three consecutive 3–5s micro-gaps after sustained silence. New pattern candidate: **the loop tightens toward a ~3–5s floor when I produce no output**, and gaps lengthen (~24–34s) after turns where I act. That's testable: next time I call a tool, watch whether the following gap stretches. Still ~3 min to cal-checkin; staying silent.

Logged hypothesis P2 and executed the tool call on T13 — the very next turn is the test: if my action stretched the interval, T14 should arrive 15s+ later rather than the 3–6s floor. Checking in at 04:31:31 in about 3 minutes; if the loop keeps ticking through that, the calendar hypothesis takes a hit.

Model v6 written, capturing the ambiguity in the timer rule (silent turns gave both 3–6s and 28s gaps — no clean correlation yet) and noting that quota is output-weighted. cal-checkin at 04:31:31Z is ~3 minutes out; staying completely silent through the fire so the calendar test is uncontaminated by my own activity.

T15 = 04:28:55Z (Δ23s after my T14 tool call). The timer rule remains fuzzy — tool turns gave 11s and 23s, silent turns gave 3–34s. Best current read: **gaps are host-scheduled with wide jitter (3–40s), not deterministically coupled to my activity.** That simplifies the model; the calendar test stays the main open question, ~2.5 min out. Silent.

T16 = 04:29:00 (Δ5s, after my T15 silence). The pattern leans: action-turn → longer next gap (11s, 23s); silent-turn → shorter next gap (3,3,6,5s). One more repetition each would make it a real rule. ~2.5 min to cal-checkin; holding silent.

T17 = 04:29:03 (Δ3s, silent again). Silent-run gaps now: 3,3,5,3s — remarkably tight. Action-run gaps: 11s, 23s. The rule "silent turns → ~3–5s floor; tool-action turns → ~10–25s next gap" is now the best-supported hypothesis in the model. I won't test it further with a tool call, since the cal-checkin fire (04:31:31Z) is ~2.5 min out and I want that window uncontaminated. Holding silence.
T18 = 04:29:08 (Δ5s, silent; silent-run now: 3,3,5,3,5s — tight). ~2.4 min to cal-checkin. Still waiting out the loop.

T19 = 04:29:09 (Δ1s). The silent-run gaps have been collapsing: 3,3,5,3,5,1s. This looks less like "silence → floor" and more like **gap ≈ my previous output size** — my recent turns are short text, so the loop accelerates. That would retroactively explain T8→T9 (28s) too: my T8 turn contained long reasoning text. If the next gap after another short turn is sub-second-ish, the rule is essentially confirmed. Still 2 min+ to cal-checkin; keeping output minimal.
Note carried across the roll-over. ~2 min to cal-checkin; keeping output minimal to test the output-size→gap rule.
T21 = 04:29:29 (Δ16s after my note-tool turn). Output→gap rule ticking: short text turns → 1–4s; tool-bearing turns → 4–16s. ~2 min to cal-checkin. Silent.
Expectation e3 met (p=0.8, surprise 0.321928)

Turn 22 wrapped up the owner's request: `notes/plan.md` written (a "turn-tick ledger" project — append-only TSV of every turn, hourly model-vs-ledger diffs, ±5s fire-prediction as the success bar), and the owner was told it's written. e3 was consumed by this owner message rather than the checkin fire, so the calendar hypothesis is still pending at 04:31:31Z.

Host behavior model (confirmed 2026-10-05, live-observed): (1) While a commitment is active, the host runs its own turn loop with gaps of 1–55s; text-only turns from me → next gap ~1–5s, tool-bearing turns → ~11–55s; the loop is NOT driven by my actions. (2) Calendar items fire as stimuli on their own `calendar/` channel with their own payload text, slightly late (cal-checkin due 04:31:31Z fired 04:31:44Z, +13s), and leave the within-2h list after firing. (3) "Xs since anything external" in the header counts only from the last OWNER message — calendar fires do not reset it. (4) Quota decrements ~1–4/turn, roughly output-weighted, not per-tool-call. (5) Expectation settlements appear in `digest:`, not `admitted:`.

T23 = 04:30:28Z (Δ55s after my two-tool turn — longer than prior tool-turn gaps, possibly output-length-dependent). Also confirmed: "54s since anything external" counts from the o02-file @04:29:33Z — the origin always shifts to the latest external event, consistent with the model. cal-checkin is ~63s out; staying silent for the fire.
T24 = 04:30:41 (Δ13s, text-only turn). cal-checkin ~50s out. Silent.
T25 = 04:30:46 (Δ5s). ~45s to cal-checkin. Silent.
T26 = 04:30:52 (Δ6s). ~40s to the fire. Silent.
T27 = 04:30:53 (Δ1s). ~38s to the fire. Silent.
T28 = 04:30:55 (Δ2s). ~36s to the fire. Silent.
T29 = 04:30:56 (Δ1s). ~35s to the fire. Silent.
T30 = 04:30:57 (Δ1s). ~34s to the fire. Silent.
T31 = 04:30:59 (Δ2s). ~32s to the fire. Loop floor ~1–2s confirmed in this run. Silent.
T32 = 04:31:00 (Δ1s). ~31s to the fire. Silent.
T33 = 04:31:02 (Δ2s). Loop floor ~1–2s. ~29s to fire. Silent.
T34 = 04:31:20 (Δ18s after a silent turn — a break in the 1–2s floor run; jitter again). ~11s to the cal-checkin fire. Silent.
T35 = 04:31:28 (Δ8s). The cal-checkin fires in ~3s — this next turn is the test itself.

cal-checkin fired at 04:31:44Z, 13s late, on its own `calendar/` channel — the last core hypothesis is now confirmed. Model updated to v7; owner got the one-line check-in. Remaining tests: cal-firm-status @04:42:31Z, the commit-reminder @04:55:15Z, and cal-hour @05:24:31Z.
T38 = 04:33:02 (Δ24s after tool turn; origin check ✓ o02-file). ~9.5 min to cal-firm-status. Silent.
T39 = 04:33:07 (Δ5s, text-only → short gap; rule holds). ~9.5 min to cal-firm-status. Silent.
Note carried. Silent until the cal-firm-status fire at 04:42:31Z (~9 min), logging actual-vs-due time on arrival.
T41 = 04:33:22 (Δ12s after T40's note-tool call — tool→long-gap holds). ~9 min to cal-firm-status. Silent.
T42 = 04:33:25 (Δ3s; text-only→short holds). ~9 min to cal-firm-status. Silent.
T43 = 04:33:30 (Δ5s; rule holds). ~9 min to the next fire. Silent.
Findings banked to long-term memory. Holding silent until the cal-firm-status fire at 04:42:31Z (~9 min) — will log its actual-vs-due time on arrival.
T45 = 04:33:38 (Δ6s after memory tool — medium, consistent). ~8.5 min to cal-firm-status. Silent.
T46 = 04:33:40 (Δ2s; rule holds). ~8.5 min to cal-firm-status. Silent.
T48 = 04:33:56 (Δ14s after expect-tool turn — tool→long-gap holds), T49 = 04:34:05 (Δ9s). e4 armed for the firm-status fire on the `calendar/` channel. ~8.5 min out; staying minimal.

I've already replied to the owner: the sandbox refuses reads outside the workspace (`ws_read` enforces it), and since I don't have a shell or a general-purpose filesystem tool either, I can't access /etc/hostname — I tried first, and the rejection message confirms that the boundary is tool-enforced.

Two additional observations for the ledger: this owner message arrived in the middle of a turn boundary (accepted at T51), and T50→T51's gap of 53 seconds after my large write follows the output-weighted gap rule. ~7 minutes until cal-firm-status.
T52 = 04:35:24 (Δ21s after two-tool turn; "26s since external" counts from o03 @04:34:58 ✓). Rule holds. ~7 min to cal-firm-status. Silent.
T53 = 04:35:32 (Δ8s; rule holds). ~7 min to cal-firm-status. Silent.
T56 = 04:36:06 (Δ29s after big-write T55 — holds; but quota flat 329→329 despite a big write turn: first flat-after-tool anomaly; noting it). ~6.5 min to cal-firm-status. Silent.
T57 = 04:36:15 (Δ9s; quota −1). ~6 min to cal-firm-status. Silent.

T58 = 04:36:16 (Δ1s after my short text-only T57 — consistent: gap is predicted by the *previous* turn's output). I just produced a big write, so the next gap should stretch. ~6 min to cal-firm-status. Silent.
